articles.title: Woman found with severe injuries in Vaughan
articles.summary: York Regional Police are investigating after a woman was found with severe injuries near a major road in Vaughan on Tuesday afternoon. Police were called to the area of Pine Valley Drive, near Major Mackenzie and Ballantyne Drives, just before 3 p.m. The woman’s condition and the cause of her injuries was not immediately known. […]

articles.title: Man charged with assault after volunteer for Mississauga mayoral candidate attacked
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police have charged a 60-year-old man with assault with a weapon after a volunteer for Mississauga mayoral candidate Alvin Tedjo was attacked while putting up election signs.

articles.title: Industry minister presses Stelco’s U.S. owner to present job-saving plan in 5 days
articles.summary: OTTAWA — The federal government is turning up the heat on the U.S. owner of Stelco Holdings Inc. over impending layoffs at the Hamilton, Ont.-based steel plant.

articles.summary: Liberal Member of Parliament for Scarborough Southwest Doly Begum has officially endorsed mayoral candidate Olivia Chow for re-election to Toronto’s top job. articles.title: Mississauga mayoral candidate Alvin Tedjo says campaign volunteer attacked with knife while putting up election signs
articles.summary: Mississauga mayoral candidate Alvin Tedjo says a volunteer with his campaign was attacked by a person with a knife while putting up election signs in a residential neighbourhood on Monday night. articles.title: Father tells court he feels loss every day after son killed outside Scarborough gas station
articles.summary: The father of a tow truck driver killed outside a Scarborough gas station told a court on Monday he feels the loss of his son every single day.

articles.title: Family pleads for safe return of beloved bunny Biscuit after pet goes missing at Markham Fair
articles.summary: A Toronto family says it's "devastated" after their beloved pet bunny Biscuit went missing at the annual Markham Fair, with both the family and fair organizers saying they believe he was stolen.

articles.title: 2 charged, 1 suspect outstanding in connection with death of Scarborough man found inside burning vehicle
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and one suspect remains outstanding in connection with the death of a Scarborough man found inside a burning vehicle in September, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Crown says DNA evidence helped ID man now on trial for decades-old sex assaults against children
articles.summary: Prosecutors told a jury in Brampton, Ont., on Monday, how DNA evidence had linked three brutal attacks against children in the 1990s to Richard Neil, now 67 and on trial for charges including kidnapping, sexual assault causing bodily harm and administering a stupefying drug.

articles.title: 3 candidates vying for front-runner status ahead of Mississauga election: poll
articles.summary: It's going to be a tight mayoral race in Mississauga with three candidates, including the current and former mayors, now neck and neck among decided and leaning voters, a new poll suggests.
